name: Garden of Lights at Heathcote Botanical Gardens
when_note: Select evenings in December, 5:30 to 9 PM
cost: Adults $15; children ages 6 to 17 $5; children under 6 free; members $10
paras: Heathcote Botanical Gardens lists Garden of Lights on twelve evenings in December 2026: December 4, 5, 6, 11, 12, 13, 14, 18, 19, 20, 26 and 27, from 5:30 PM to 9 PM. The gardens are at 210 Savannah Road in Fort Pierce.

The host lists admission at $15 for adults, $5 for children ages 6 to 17, free for children under 6, and $10 for members. Kids can follow a scavenger hunt with a prize, Santa appears on select nights, and food trucks are on site.
tip: Check the host page for which nights Santa visits before you pick a date.

name: A Spectacular Christmas at the Sunrise Theatre
address: 117 South Second Street, Fort Pierce, FL 34950
when_note: One night only, with a Santa visit in the lobby before the show
paras: South Florida Dance Company presents A Spectacular Christmas at the Sunrise Theatre in downtown Fort Pierce on Saturday, December 19, 2026 at 7 PM, one night only. The host calls it a full length theatrical dance production for children from one to ninety-two.

The story follows a family separated during the holidays and hoping to be reunited by Christmas morning. The host lists Rockettes-inspired numbers, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, Santa Claus and a portrayal of the Nativity. Young audience members can see Santa in the theatre lobby before the performance. The host page does not print a ticket price.
tip: Arrive early for the lobby visit with Santa before the curtain.

name: The Nutcracker by St. Lucie Ballet at the Sunrise Theatre
address: 117 South Second Street, Fort Pierce, FL 34950
paras: The Sunrise Theatre lists St. Lucie Ballet's The Nutcracker on Friday, December 4, 2026 at 7 PM, with doors at 6 PM. The theatre calls it a full length Treasure Coast tradition of 22 years in the Main Theatre.
The theatre page does not print ticket prices or an age guide, so check the box office, 772-461-4775, before you buy.
tip: Doors open an hour early, which helps families settle young children.
